idea-plugin.name: Tokyo Night Islands
idea-plugin.description:
Tokyo Night theme for the JetBrains Islands UI.

A child theme of the bundled Islands Dark theme, so it inherits the current platform look (rounded islands, spacing, component styling) and applies the Tokyo Night palette on top. Includes a matching editor color scheme.

Colors are based on Tokyo Night by enkia (VS Code) and the tokyonight.nvim palette by folke.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.0
